Francis Ford Coppola Bet More Than $100 Million on His Legacy. Now What?
bullets.note:
(WSJ). From the article: “The director talks about his passion project, _Megalopolis_, including reports of problems on set and how he paid for the film.” Writer [Trung Phan](https://x.com/TrungTPhan) shared the below article summary [on Twitter](https://x.com/TrungTPhan/status/1839712186794377506) of how Coppola financed _Megalopolis_:

_In 2021, Coppola merged his winery with Napa-based Delicato Family Wines_

_Merged business valued at $650m_

_Secured a $200m line of credit from a bank using his remaining stake in winery (he sold a piece as part of merger)_

_He filmed in Georgia and bought a Days Inn hotel for $4m to house the cast and crew (such a baller move)_

_After generous Georgia film subsidies, the film production budget totalled $107m_

_He is spending another $17m on distribution and marketing costs (and balance of funds on various other expenses)_

For more on Coppola, check out Trung’s “[Francis Ford Coppola: The Entrepreneur](https://www.readtrung.com/p/francis-ford-coppola-the-entrepreneur).” I will also be listening to my friend and past podcast guest Ryan Holiday’s [interview with Coppola](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G3tWx2Jqc5Q), which was the director’s first-ever podcast appearance.

bullets.title: Massachusetts will vote on creating legal, regulated, therapeutic access to psychedelic medicines in a few short weeks
bullets.note:
I’m supporting this financially and hope Massachusetts residents will do the same by voting (or more). But what is it? [Question 4](https://maformentalhealth.org/) is a citizen-initiated ballot that creates a regulated framework for supervised use of certain psychedelics at licensed psychedelic therapy centers. It does _not_ legalize retail sales or storefronts.  
​  
Army veteran CJ LoConte supports “Yes on 4,” and you can [watch him tell his personal story here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XVh0B7zHfaY). One of the campaign’s videos features the story of [Emily Oneschuk](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oXibzL0ral8), the first female Navy SEAL candidate. You can learn more about “Yes on 4” and watch short video examples of healing [here](https://maformentalhealth.org/).
